I'm checking whether "pseudodeficiency" counts as a disease. It reads as a benign, non-disease state, so I'm leaning toward excluding it.

I'm going through the remaining candidates. "TSD" as a short form for Tay-Sachs disease counts as a specific disease mention, but where it modifies another noun, as in "TSD carriers", "TSD heterozygotes" or "French TSD patient", it's a modifier. Pseudodeficiency isn't a disease, so it gets no annotation.
